name: _grid.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs/_grid.scss — the folder/file grid with generated SVG glyphs.
//  Imported by docs.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_DOCS} {
  // ── Folder/file grid with generated glyphs ────────────────────────────
  &-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(to-rem($space-5xl), 1fr));
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
  }

  &-card {
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 90%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    // Cards are <a href> (crawlable docs routes) — read as buttons did.
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-sm);
    transition: border-color 0.4s ease;

    &:focus-visible,
    &:hover {
      border-color: currentColor;
      outline: none;
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
    }
  }

  &-card-art {
    width: to-rem($space-4xl);
    height: to-rem($space-3xl);
    display: block;
  }

  &-card-label {
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    word-break: break-word;
    text-align: center;
  }

  // Generated folder glyph — strokes follow the theme ink.
  &-folder {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  &-folder-body {
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 1.5;
  }

  &-folder-thread {
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 0.6;
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
}
